name: Turks & Caicos
about: Dec–Apr is dry season and peak, with the calmest, clearest water for the beaches and diving; hurricane season runs Jun–Nov, risk peaking Aug–Oct.
overview: Grace Bay, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches, protected by a barrier reef that keeps the water calm and clear — a quieter, more upscale alternative to the Bahamas.
costOverview: There's very little budget tier here — Turks & Caicos leans deliberately upscale, and even simple meals run high by Caribbean standards.
monthlyWeather: dry and warm, one of the most pleasant months of the year
